snippet.title: Princess Fairy Tales Jigsaw Puzzles and Coloring Book App For Kids
snippet.description:
The perfect app for all kids loving princesses, horses, fairy tales and good stories. The app for kids (girls AND boys) contains different jigsaw puzzles with individual difficulties and a coloring book with a lot of motives.
The video shows the basic game features in a short overview.
The app can be downloaded from Apples App Store and Google Play. The Links for the Download you can find at our website at: http://www.mcpeppergames.com
